description: Few-shot examples for assembly step extraction. These examples teach the LLM the correct format and extraction rules.

examples.input_text: Place Frame 1 on the Workstation. Frame 1 is the lower frame.
Insert Screw 1 into Hole 1 of Frame 1 using a Screwdriver with CR-V 2.0mm tip. The screw has a hexagonal head, 3mm diameter and 11mm length.
Fasten Spacer 1 onto Screw 1 with a 3mm wrench. The spacer has a hexagonal body, is threaded, 3mm diameter and 10mm length.

output.component_detail: Body = Hexagonal; Threaded = True; Diameter = 3mm; Length = 10mm;

examples.input_text: Position Rail 1 between Frame 1 Corner 1 and Frame 2 Corner 1. Ensure Rail 1 has no plunger and is 113.5mm long.
Install Card 1 (Payload type) onto Bracket 1, Bracket 2, Bracket 3, and Bracket 4.

notes: Examples show the three allowed actions: Place, Insert, Screw in
applied_to uses semicolon separation for multiple targets
Empty fields are represented as empty strings, not null or omitted
assembly_detail contains extra instructions when present in source text
